answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 39 POA per identity, released only after 11 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 220 fakes must lock 8580 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. A ripple of doubt is healthy, a sonnet of proof is required, and a vine of patience is the price of a clean panel.
